calculation.description: Negative lagged recovery efficiency: favor assets that have recovered less from their 60-day low after risk normalization. The sign is explicitly contrarian because lower recovery efficiency predicted stronger subsequent returns in this cross-asset sample. All inputs are lagged one completed bar.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2028-09-06 (usable dates 2020-01-01 through 2028-09-06; common cross-sectional observations begin after rolling windows)
validation.regime_notes: Full available synthetic history with 15 tradable cross-asset instruments; conservative interpretation is required because cross-sectional sample is small. Negative raw IC was monotonic and strengthened at 1/3/5/10/20-day horizons; the 5-day sign-inverted factor clears the benchmark absolute IC and ICIR gates.
